static_traits.name: Lin Ruo
static_traits.educational_background: Master's degree in library and information science
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends, but often feels they do not fully understand oneself; at Work seeing colleagues socialize and build relationships, oneself mostly in the 'bystander' position
static_traits.medical_history: No obvious physical illness; no previous psychotherapy/psychiatric treatment history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic, able to Reflect on and examine one's own thoughts; emotional identification in place (Loneliness, Anxiety); high cooperation and motivation for change, Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling that being an introverted person is hindering one's social life and Personal growth, gradually Feeling isolated, difficulty building connections with others.
basic_info.core_demands: Hopes to better enjoy life and form meaningful relationships, so seeks counseling to improve social and connection abilities.
growth_experiences: After starting Librarian Work a few years ago, long periods of Being alone, very few social activities outside Work, gradually worsening sense of Loneliness, increasingly feeling it hard to build connections with others.

At Work often seeing colleagues socialize and build relationships together, feeling like an outsider; for example, recently colleagues invited for lunch, though invited, made excuses not to attend due to Anxiety and worries about not fitting in, regretting afterwards.

Lacking specific experiences of being clearly rejected or judged, yet long harboring Anticipatory Fear of being judged/being rejected; also having been accepted in multiple positive social interactions (close friends enjoying one's company, having fun and feeling accepted by colleagues at some Work activities), but prone to ignoring this positive evidence when Anxious.

core_beliefs: I am unable to fit in with others

special_situations.event: Colleagues arrange to go out for lunch and invite oneself to join
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not outgoing or interesting enough, I will be judged or rejected by others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing, protecting oneself by making excuses not to attend
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will find me boring, awkward; I will be out of place

special_situations.event: At work, sees colleagues socializing and building relationships
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot socialize and fit in like them, it shows something is wrong with me, lagging in Personal growth
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Giving oneself the negative label of 'too introverted'; reluctantly pushing oneself to socialize but often ending in failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am always an outsider; I am inferior to them

special_situations.event: Anticipation when facing new social invitations or group activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is a possibility of being judged, I should avoid to prevent embarrassment or being rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids or withdraws in advance, reduces exposure to social situations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time will surely be very awkward / I will not fit in

special_situations.event: When reviewing past social experiences to assess reality
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive experiences are not representative, cannot show I can be accepted
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or belittles positive evidence, focusing only on possible negative outcomes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those were just coincidences; this time will not go so smoothly

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and to build close and meaningful relationships
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged or rejected by others, appearing awkward and not fitting in
defense_goal: Maintaining safe distance and reducing the risk of being negated by avoiding group activities and labeling oneself 'too introverted'

object_relations.object_representation: Others/groups who may judge or reject me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Used when discussing participation in group socializing (such as colleague dinners) or when the counselor invites reality testing and challenging negative labels
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to see others as potential judges, believing once oneself is exposed one will be negated (transference: Projecting the Fear of being judged onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopting a supportive and Empathic tone, first validating their Anxiety and worries; Guiding them to concretize evidence with gentle rhetorical questions, conducting reality testing, gradually identifying and replacing negative labels.

manifestations: Long-term Being alone at Work and in life, few social activities
Sees colleagues socializing but feels like an outsider
Craving connection and meaningful relationships but avoiding due to Anxiety
outcomes: Anxiety and Decreased sense of happiness

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Presupposing when facing group activities that others will find oneself boring or awkward
Assuming oneself will be judged or rejected without specific evidence

contact_model.definition: The individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Expressed in language as: 'forget it, I will endure', 'I should not trouble others', etc.
manifestations: Suppressing the urge to participate when colleagues invite for lunch, making excuses not to go instead
In social situations, when nervous, self-inhibits and reduces expression and participation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Labels oneself negatively as 'too introverted' and limits socializing accordingly
Excessively cares about others' views, being cautious in socializing and avoiding risks

exception_events.target_problem: In colleagues' group social situations, the client typically becomes Anxious from worrying about being judged and chooses avoidance, making it hard to build connections.
exception_events.unique_outcome: At several Work activities, she did not Withdraw as usual, had great fun after participating and felt accepted by colleagues.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: trying to participate and stay longer; different understanding: experiencing actual acceptance in the activity, discovering the Fear was not fact.

exception_events.target_problem: In situations of building relationships with people, the client typically worries about being seen as boring or awkward, thereby reducing outings and socializing.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Interactions with several close friends have consistently gone smoothly; they have clearly expressed enjoying being with her, and there have been many pleasant shared experiences.
exception_events.reason: Different relationships: being with familiar and supportive friends, higher sense of security; different evidence: direct positive feedback helping correct their worries.

positive_force: A stable work and life structure provides a predictable environment for trying socializing
Has experienced acceptance and pleasure in work activities and interactions with family and friends
Good self-Reflection ability, willing to conduct reality testing and cognitive restructuring
Has a few close friends for emotional support
High motivation to change, good cooperation
negative_force: Marked tendency toward Social avoidance and self-limitation
Cognitive distortions such as mind reading and predicting the future, over-caring about others' evaluations
negating positive evidence (mental filtering/negating the positive), Reinforcing the negative self-label 'too introverted'
Long-term Being alone and low social frequency intensifying the sense of Loneliness
Introjection of extroversion as a value standard, rigidifying self-evaluation

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance (making excuses not to attend / leaving early when invited or in group activities)
antecedent: Seeing colleagues at parties and events
About to participate in new group social settings
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being judged or rejected, being seen as boring or awkward; based on negative cognition of mind reading and predicting the future, long-term Being alone leading to insufficient confidence.
target_behavior.function: Escaping uncomfortable Anxiety and potential negation, maintaining subjective security and sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Missing opportunities to build connections, worsened sense of Loneliness, regret afterwards, further Reinforcing the belief 'I do not fit in'

target_behavior.behavior: Self-labeling and negative self-statements (such as 'I am too introverted')
antecedent: When seeing others socialize and comparing
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjection of extroversion as a self-worth standard; overgeneralization and mental filtering, ignoring positive social evidence.
target_behavior.function: Providing seemingly reasonable Interpretations for avoidance and Withdrawal, reducing uncertainty and Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem, weakened social drive, maintaining and intensifying avoidance behaviors
